Installed the openai npm package (v6.39.0) and refactored all three OpenAI API lib files to use the official SDK instead of raw fetch calls. Updated getHtmlFromOpenAI.ts to use gpt-4o (replacing the deprecated gpt-4-vision-preview), and replaced raw fetch in getCodeFromOpenAI.ts and getInterpretationFromAI.ts. Also fixed the callers (generateCode.tsx and interpretShapes.tsx) to remove the now-unnecessary json.error checks and handle the SDK's typed null-safe content field. TypeScript type check passes with zero errors.
